description: CozyRadio Mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric). Drop the Cozy Radio disc in a jukebox and every player nearby tunes into an endless, server-synced internet radio stream — MP3 relays and personal YouTube live stations.

mods.name: CozyRadio Mod (Fabric)
mods.description: Craft a Cozy Radio disc, pop it into a jukebox, and every player nearby tunes into an endless, server-synchronized internet radio stream — MP3 relays and the YouTube live radios players add themselves, decoded natively via Lavaplayer.

releases.notes:
**Beta release** — expect occasional rough edges; config/save formats may change between betas. Stable release planned once the format settles. of CozyRadio Mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 (Fabric). Install on the server and every client (or in singleplayer) — Fabric API required.

## New in 1.1.0

- **YouTube OAuth authorization** — when a YouTube station needs a logged-in account, the client posts a clickable link and a one-time code in the **in-game chat**. Complete it once per client and the refresh token is saved to `config/cozyradio-mod/youtube-oauth.json`; the waiting stream resumes on its own. Fixes silent playback of login-required videos and bot-checked networks.
- **Dead-player detection** — streams that never produce audio now reconnect instead of staying silent forever.
- **Personal stations are keyed by the player's chosen name** — older `yours-<videoId>` ids migrate automatically.
- **Station completions** — `/cozyradio station` tab-completes your own personal stations; labels must be a single word.
